claims.text: Highly accomplished Backend Engineer with over 6 years of experience designing and implementing scalable, low-latency services using Rust, Python, and PostgreSQL. Proven expertise in cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes) and leading complex migrations and development teams to ensure high availability and performance improvements.
Senior Backend Engineer at Northwind Logistics, Austin TX, March 2021 to June 2024
• Built a Rust order-routing service handling 40,000 requests per minute and cut p99 latency by 35 percent.
• Led a team of four engineers and migrated PostgreSQL 12 to 15 with no downtime.
Software Engineer at Fabrikam Health, Remote, January 2018 to February 2021
• Wrote Python data pipelines on AWS Lambda that processed 2 million claims per day, and added integration tests that reduced production incidents by 20 percent.
Rust, Python, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS, gRPC
B.S. Computer Science, University of Texas at Austin, 2017
